steps.content:
July 25, N.F. 114
DisCity

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief! Over here! I found a great anime series, collector's edition!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Please forget about it. The recent snack order has already used up all the budget.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hella isn't here. Plus, Chief is loaded. We rarely take vacations, so let's splurge a little.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh! And that one! The new game!
There are still some rifts left in the sky, but they will no longer release monsters or disturb the peace.
Time rewinds to before the chaos. You remember the culprit dragging you to another world. You remember that she killed some strange "gods," and...

Some details have become blurry. For example, you've forgotten what that person looks like. Researchers who experienced the incident speculate that all memories of it will eventually vanish, though the forgetting process will vary depending on the person and event.
Perhaps those who especially value something will retain memories of it a bit longer.
But even these memories probably won't last long. The residual light fades, and the scars gradually heal. These are signs of the end.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you okay?
You force yourself to flash her a smile.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You look really tired. We can call it a day and head back to rest.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I think that world is also safe now.
[Scene Change] Chief's Office
At night, you hear a noise outside the door and push it open.

steps.speaker: Little Kitty
steps.content: ...Meow?
There's no one at the door. Looking down, you see a kitty cat at your feet.
Labyrinth quickly arrives and picks it up.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Sorry, Chief, it followed me here. Recently, my attraction to felines has increased. I'll take it away now.
[Scene Change] Nirvana Hospital

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Agent Moore has submitted a technical report to the center. The dark web threat has been eliminated. Sinner 000 is dead, and the anomaly is in its final contraction phase.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Digitalized Mania gave the Sinners involved varying degrees of memory fluctuations. However, since the shackles are in place, there are no major problems. They just need some time to heal.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: As for the "extra-dimensional" world everyone experienced...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Similar to the Elysiland incident, it has been classified as a virtual space constructed by Sinner 000, an illusion generated by Mania.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: That's the summary of it. The full report is 733 pages and has been sent to your inbox.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Good work. You're always so reliable.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Thank you. Also, I'm here to bid you farewell. I've resigned.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have 000's words got to you? Are you worried that this world...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: No, no. I don't care about the truth or falsehood of gods or games. Those are from the work. I've seen all sorts of absurd things at work. Plus, you've paid me well.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...It's just some trivial sentimentality.
[Entering Memory]

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: You can't do that! She'll be treated as a mole and disposed of as such!

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Why do you care? It's just part of your job. She's an entity from another world, a virtual object if you will.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Relax, Rise. You've done an excellent job.
[Exit Memory]
Rise is silent for a moment, then looks at you again.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: I understand the logic, and I have no resentment. I just need some time to do something to make myself feel better. So, I'm here to say goodbye.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Thinking back on the days we worked together, you caused me a lot of trouble, broke many of my principles, and gave me endless overtime. It was really unpleasant.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: But after it ended, I felt it was more worthwhile than ever.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Goodbye, Chief. I wish you all the best.
She bows to you and prepares to leave.
You clasp your hands together, think for a long time, then look up at her.
There is one more thing I need your help with. Something... that can only be done by someone I trust.
[Moore's house]
The doorbell rings for a while before a woman's voice responds from inside, followed by chaotic clatter.
The door opens. Moore stands there wrapped in a bath towel, her hair wet and gleaming in the light. Water drips down her skin and onto the floor.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Sorry, I was in the shower and didn't hear the doorbell. Just leave the delivery at the door.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Huh? Chief, why are you here? Ah...!!

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: We finally meet again, and here I am looking like a mess. So sorry, can you wait a moment? I'll tidy up the place. It'll be quick.
She tries to close the door and go back inside, but you hold the door open with one hand.
You glance at her misty glasses and then inside the room. Several screens flicker faintly amidst swirling steam, and you hear the sound of running water. Beyond that, it's too dim to see anything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need to talk to you. Can I come in?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Now? But...
You take off her foggy glasses, stopping her mid-sentence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right Moore, let's cut to the point. You’re not exactly an expert at faking a scene.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are there really that many things in this room that need to be hidden?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm not here to ask about those things. I have urgent matters that need your help. There's not much time to waste.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My companions downstairs, however, are a different story...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can we talk, dark web expert?
Moore looks at you for a long time as the clock ticks.
A small mechanical assistant slowly floats out from behind, flashing lights to greet the guest.
She finally smiles, takes back the glasses, and wipes off the mist. After putting them back on, she no longer looks flustered. The tech expert beams a sunny smile.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Got it. Chief, please come in.
She leads you inside and closes the door.
